_doc: Per-character reveal gating for punk_records infobox fields. The Spoiler Shield gates a fact on the chapter the READER LEARNS it, never on the character's debut. Two shapes: `name` is a rung ladder (the display name changes as the story reveals it); every other key is a plain chapter number meaning 'hide this field below this chapter'. Consumed by character.html via bake.py block `field-reveals-data`.

_policy.name: Ordered rungs [{ch, value, jp, romaji}]. Highest rung with ch <= cutoff wins; below the first rung the first rung is used. Display only — c.name remains the lookup key everywhere.
_policy.field_gate: Plain integer. Field is hidden while cutoff < ch.
_policy.undated: Fields with no entry are shown (fail-open). This is a KNOWN RESIDUAL: unlike `status`, omitting every undated field would strip most of the infobox for shielded readers. The annotation scrubber in character.html catches the common cross-cutting leaks ('(former)', '(at death)', '(after timeskip)'). Extend this file as leaks are found.
_policy.fail_late: When torn between two candidate chapters take the LATER one.

_qa_flags: Charlotte Linlin: name rung at 828 is a deliberate fail-late over-hide; 'Big Mom' is used from 651 and the Charlotte name appears earlier than 828. Confirm and tighten.
Nico Robin: 218 used for the 'Nico Robin' name reveal -- confirm the exact chapter.
Kouzuki Momonosuke: 819 used for the Kouzuki lineage reveal -- confirm.
Marshall D. Teach: 234 used for the full-name reveal after the Blackbeard debut at 223 -- confirm.
Only 8 name ladders are authored. Any character whose stored name is a later, fuller form than their debut name still leaks. Candidates surface via the alias heuristic in codex-coverage-check.
